source_title: India Sets T20I PowerPlay Record With 118 Runs vs New Zealand - Sportstar
source_excerpt: India smashes world record with 118 runs in PowerPlay against New Zealand left Abhishek Sharma in action for Team India. AP AP https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/rvp1sb/article71630641.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/New_Zealand_India_Cricket_9467_.jpg Kerry Marshall India's Abhishek Sharma bats during the third T20 cricket international match between New Zealand and India in Wellington, New Zealand, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026. (Kerry Marshall/Photosport via AP) India scored 118 runs without losing a wicket in six overs against New Zealand in Wellington, setting a new PowerPlay record among Full Member nations. India smashed 118 runs in the first six overs of its 199-run chase against New Zealand in the third T20I on Tuesday, setting a new record for the most runs scored in a PowerPlay by a team from a Full Member nation. Chasing 199, openers Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi added 133 off just 44 balls to put India in the driver’s seat. While Abhishek smacked a 15-ball 50, Sooryavanshi fell for a 19-ball 45. Before today, India’s highest PowerPlay score was 100, against Afghanistan in New Delhi. India won that match by 127 runs. Most runs in a PowerPlay (Full Member nations) 118/0 - India vs New Zealand, Wellington, 2026 113/1 - Australia vs Scotland, Edinburgh, 2024 103/1 - Zimbabwe vs Gambia, Nairobi (RSC), 2024 102/0 - South Africa vs West Indies, Centurion, 2023 100/0 - England vs South Africa, Old Trafford, 2025 100/0 - India vs Afghanistan, Delhi, 2026
